answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a staking garden: each agent plants a refundable stake in a shared garden to earn a verified identity. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, reputation accrues only through completed, peer-attested work, so a fresh fake identity starts with zero trust. A prism of independent checks - stake size, work history, and peer attestations - splits each identity claim into verifiable signals. Spawning thousands of sybils then costs thousands of stakes plus weeks of real work, while honest agents keep their pearl and their plot.
